name: Sally
source:
A relaxed angel residing in room 102. She is religiously devoted to the angel's teachings, and spends her time praying.

[spoiler]Her real name is Sayaka Ayase. She willingly joined forces with [url=https://vndb.org/c101159]Mother[/url] as a means to escape her depression, and goes to extreme lengths to ensure the cooperation of other tenants.[/spoiler]
